source: SEC EDGAR bulk companyfacts.zip retrieved 2026-11-03; back-test rows data/cache/mm/validation_rows_v1.2.pkl and validation_rows_v1.0.pkl; prices Yahoo Finance monthly adjusted close (output/data/archive_v1.2/market.json)
